_doc: The daily story's editable rules (Docs/StoryFlywheel/README.md). story.py reads this; nothing else. Garrett steers here: the song and its beat slots, the end card, which part of the game an activity belongs to, and how a name is said on screen.

song._slots: SKY FIRE, 123 BPM: the bar-aligned cut points of trailer v2 (Tools/Build/trailer/edl-v2.json). The drop is 46.08.

_elements: Every cut shows PvP, maneuvering, destruction and creation (Garrett, 2026-11-12). staged_elements says which element a staged trailer shot shows; real clips carry theirs in their names. camera is how shoot.py films each element: wide, slow, never tight (min_distance, min_chase_back).

camera._why: Garrett 2026-11-12: a 14-unit chase showed only the vessel; the first wide pass (110/55/300) made it a speck. These are about 60% of that. Round 3: a 33 chase lost the hull in trail fields and PvP at 70 read as two trails, so maneuvering is a side-on tracking shot and PvP sits at 45 on duels within 30 units. Round 4: PvP framed on both at 45 made two dots, so PvP is over the shoulder of one pilot looking at the other (ots).
